display_long_description:
Every pop counts in **Stress Buster by sportyxr!** Pop balloons, avoid bombs, and time your abilities and power balloons to chase your highest score.

**PLAY YOUR WAY**

Play in a 3D virtual room or your real surroundings with passthrough. Use VR controllers or your own hands with hand tracking.

**FOUR GAME MODES**

- **Classic:** Three bomb hits end your run.
- **Arcade:** Chase your best score in 60 seconds. Bombs deduct 50 points without reducing lives.
- **Multiplayer:** Create a room, share the code, and play with friends.
- **Event:** Enjoy special events with new backgrounds and event music. Round duration follows the song.

**CHOOSE YOUR ABILITIES**

Equip two abilities at a time, one per hand. Pop 20 balloons to enable ability use.

- **Magnet Pulse:** Pull balloons closer for 3 seconds.
- **Shield:** Protect yourself from bombs for 3 seconds.
- **Slow Field:** Slow balloons for 3 seconds.
- **Echo Pop:** Trigger a nearby balloon-popping chain reaction.

**POWER UP YOUR SCORE**

Normal balloons earn **+10**, golden balloons earn **+50**, and bombs cost **-50** points.

- **Double Strike:** Double points for 5 seconds.
- **Golden Rush:** All balloons turn golden for 5 seconds.

Check player scores on the leaderboard and make every pop count!
